name: FSL-CP
description: A benchmark for few-shot prediction of small-molecule activity using cell microscopy images.
reputation: A recent, domain-specific benchmark with limited adoption so far outside the originating research group and drug-discovery imaging labs.
notes: Few-shot setting with likely small, imbalanced classes; microscopy-specific batch effects and imaging artifacts can bias results; non-LLM, vision-focused benchmark; contamination/baseline overlap risk if molecular labels come from public assays.
